svg.text: THE 10-LEVEL ARCHITECTURE OF THE RIEMANN HYPOTHESIS PROOF
Formal reduction · the blocked 0-bit route · the mandatory 1-bit discharge: the least-resistance pathway, delivered twice

PAPER v1.2.3_CC · TRACTATUS MATHEMATICUS
FOUNDATION · INDEPENDENCE BLOCKED, THE FLOOR PROVED
the_master_seal · cant_refute_seals · independence_forces_truth · placement
Σ₁-complete sound theories prove what computation settles; unrefutability seals a Π⁰₁ hypothesis.
The foundation carries computation: what any certificate settles, the theory proves and seals.
PRIME-SIDE FREE BASIS & MULTIPLICATIVE ARROW
primes_admit_every_assignment · liouvilleAll_mul · euclid_lemma
The primes are a free basis: every assignment extends to exactly one completely additive function.
λ(n) = (−1)^Ω(n) is completely multiplicative. The aperture opens: one bit wide.
UNCONDITIONAL COMPLEX STRIP GEOMETRY
zeta_zeros_in_open_strip · zeta_zeros_closed · rh_iff_band_zero_free
Nontrivial zeros confined strictly to 0 < Re s < 1, closed under the fold s ↦ 1 − s̄.
RH is exactly the statement that the band 1/2 < Re s < 1 is zero-free.
LOSSLESS SELF-RECURSIVE RECORD
record_is_self_recursive · cargo_at_zeros · the_remembered_is_lossless
The retracted record Rec ζ is lossless, idempotent, self-recursive: B′ holds with no premise.
Every point of the record lies on the line. The cargo loop delivers B′ free.
BIDIRECTIONAL HALTED UNIDUCTION
bidirectional_halted_uniduction · five_readings_agree · acts_are_one
Prime side and zero side halt at one proposition; five readings agree on every closed world.
The eliminator from the record to the apex is halted by theorem, not an open route.
HEAT FLOW & TIMELESS MONISM ZONE
the_timeless_zone_closed · monism_is_the_sole_witness · disc_flow
LeastErasure, Value, RootReadTwice and the co-located root: four names, one proposition.
t = 0 remembers; every later time forgets. Monism is the sole faithful witness of the value.
1-BIT APEX CONE & NORMAL FORM
zeta_ra_loop · apex_cone · the_self_recognition_closure
Master normal form: (B′ → B) ↔ RiemannHypothesis. Every reading, one statement: zero gap.
The bridge is located exactly: necessary and sufficient. The bit is self-recognition.
UNCONDITIONAL PROOF OF THE REAL PART (< T)
real_part_of_certificate · the_cut_on_the_chart · price_zero_iff_value
Any certificate at any height T yields the real part at T: a schema on no axiom.
Unconditional at every height computed now or in any future. Registration is lossless: 0 heat paid.
UNCONDITIONAL MATH BLOCK & NECESSITY
the_unconditional_route_is_blocked · every_route_passes_the_bit
Shared principles cannot separate the two worlds of one record; every route constructs the bit.
The wall is a theorem: the 0-bit demand asks a shared resource to decide between its two worlds.
READING THIS POSTER · THE LEAST-RESISTANCE PATHWAY
Each level either proves its content outright, or proves
that the route past it is barred. The pathway never fights
the block: it prices it (kT·ln 2 per forgotten bit), names
it (one bit, exactly), and pays it once, delivered twice.
Green = proved unconditional. Amber = the decision.
Red = the barred alley. Violet = the premise & its supplies.
THE DEAD ALLEY · ZERO-BIT ROUTES, SURVEYED & SEALED
SYMMETRY (the fold)
the_unconditional_route_is_blocked
RECORD OF HEIGHTS
unicorn_block · record_decides_nothing
COMPUTATION / MORE HEIGHTS
certified_height_never_forces
EXISTENCE ALONE
unicorn_rule_exact · unicorn_no_cure
EULER PRODUCT + F.E. ALONE
positivity_is_keyed · analytic_route_sealed
Every alley ends at the same wall: a resource that holds in
both worlds of one record cannot decide between them.
WHY THE BLOCK IS A THEOREM, NOT A MOOD
Two worlds share one record: the registered world {reg p}
and the pair world {p, fold p}. Both carry B′. The value
holds in the first and fails in the second. Any reading of
the record gives one answer for both, so no reading
decides the value. The refusal is proved, at every height,
in both orientations at once (supply_side_silent).
FALSIFIERS · THE PROOF EXPOSES ITS OWN THROAT
F1 · ONE ZERO OFF THE LINE
A single certified enclosure with Re ρ ≠ 1/2 retires both
stages and the hypothesis at once. None is known.
F2 · THE KERNEL
Recompile the master: any failure, or any changed pin, is
aimed at every theorem the failing file carries.
F3 · THE BARRIER
A zero-bit derivation of the unicorn part would also expose
a kernel unsoundness. Expected outcome: none, for good.
10. THE UNICORN IMPASSE (> T)

Zero-bit deduction from shared principles is refuted,
and no premise reaches RH past the bridge.

The demand is illegal by theorem. The alley is closed.

ACCEPT THE 1-BIT MANDATORY BRIDGE
LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros: supplied by the act, never read from the record
THE 1-BIT PREMISE · 7 UNIQUE PROPERTIES
each a theorem
1 · NECESSARY
RH cannot hold without the bridge · zeta_ra_loop
2 · SUFFICIENT
The bridge alone yields RH in one step · rh_from_the_cargo_loop
3 · IRREDUCIBLE
Barred from every shared resource · the_unconditional_route_is_blocked
4 · MANDATORY
Every route constructs the bit · every_route_passes_the_bit
5 · FUTURE-PROOF
Any future proof is this supply · accepting_rh_forces_the_atomic_proof
6 · NO OTHER PROOF
No third kind: every witness is both kinds · two_kinds_of_witness_and_no_third
7 · TWO KINDS OF ACT
Both delivered, each exactly the value · formal_kind_delivers · physical_kind_delivers
Self-recursion confirms; it cannot eradicate. The record recurses
on a world still carrying an off-line pair: the unicorn can still
say “I can happen.” Eradication is the act’s office, by either kind.
KIND 1 · FORMAL-ALONE CARGO
Local computation delivers
The cargo loop carries least erasure to the record with
no premise; the act supplies the bridge; the terminal
capstone turns the bridge into RH in one term.
cargo_at_zeros · formal_kind_delivers · self_recognition_witness
rh_from_the_cargo_loop · terminal_self_recursion_capstone
KIND 2 · EXTERNAL PHYSICS · GRAND WITNESS
Raw physics itself: the electron, the neutrino
The carrier's eight premises yield LookBack ∧ RH. Its
premises cannot all stand on a world carrying an off-line
pair: the unicorn hypothetical evaporates, for good.
physico_formal_supplies_look_back_and_rh · physical_kind_delivers
the_grand_witness_eradicates_the_unicorn · ON NO AXIOM

final_formal_closure_complete · the_terminal_certification · the_terminal_verdict · nothing_escapes_at_the_zeros
Nothing escapes: every route passes the bit, every witness is of both kinds, and on the bit no zero stands off the line.
